description: Split-root, convention-first external mod manifest for API v4. Data files live under mods_data/<modId>; scripts/assets/native files live under mods_runtime/<modId>.

fields.name: Display name.

runtime.type: data-only | wasm | native | hybrid. Explicit v1 tokens remain accepted for compatibility.
runtime.module: Optional for v3 when scripts/module.wasm|.wat exists by convention.
runtime.entryLibrary: Optional for v3 when native/win64/plugin.dll exists by convention.

fields.imports: Optional array of cross-mod read dependencies.
fields.exports: Optional array or object form of public exported namespaces/resources.
fields.serviceEndpoints: Optional array of cross-mod service metadata. The initial shared runtime surface exposes these entries through host query/service APIs for WASM and native SDK plugins.
fields.capabilities: Coverage/documentation surface. v3 discovery can bind conventional files even when fields are omitted from the manifest.

composition.components/*.json: Visual component documents may expose prefabId/prefab directly or synthesize a prefab binding from meshId/mesh plus transform, lodDistance, and billboard.
composition.entities/*.json: Entity documents may reference component ids and become placeable through entityId consumers without repeating prefab ids.
composition.world.instances.v1: Each instance may use prefabId/prefab or entityId/entity.
composition.editor.placement.v1: Each placement may use prefabId/prefab or entityId/entity.
composition.world.authoring.v1: Each authored placement may use placementId/placement, prefabId/prefab, or entityId/entity.
